text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 12-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Time came back.** Reps cut post-meeting admin from about 40 minutes to 10. That went straight into more customer calls.

**2. CRM data got better.** Next steps and decision-makers were logged consistently for the first time.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated. Reps who asked up front, and explained why, saw almost no pushback.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what was meant. Managers still had to coach on reading the room.

**5. Adoption followed trust.** Usage jumped once reps knew notes wouldn't be used for surveillance.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It freed up time to use it.

What would you want from an AI note-taker?
